result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app page. One involves a truncated restaurant name and another involves a partially visible category filter button.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated/cut off. The full name is not visible, likely 'Trattoria Piccolo' or similar.
issues.suggestion: Either reduce the font size, allow text wrapping, or ensure the card width accommodates the full restaurant name. Alternatively, use ellipsis (...) consistently so users know the name is truncated.

issues.description: The last category filter pill (rightmost, after 'Healthy') is partially visible and cut off at the edge of the screen, with no visual indicator (like a gradient fade) to suggest horizontal scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient overlay on the right edge of the filter row to indicate that the list is horizontally scrollable, improving discoverability.
